card.quote: This is the **smallest** version of GPT-2, with 124M parameters.

gpt-2.read_from: the safetensors header of openai-community/gpt2 model.safetensors at 607a30d783dfa663caf39e06633721c8d4cfcd7e, read 2026-11-15
gpt-2.why: The level file's count is the Hub's safetensors total, which counts the 12 causal-mask buffers the checkpoint stores (attn.bias); they are not weights.

flashprove.says: the v0.1 range: r = T - 1, e = T, one checked token after a 1,024-token window

level_1.quote: For a prompt of P tokens and a reply of R, r = P − 1 and e = P + R − 1.

flashprove.why: The v1.0 runs record this card's digest, so it is kept byte for byte; the Level 1 adapter sends r = P - 1, e = P + R - 1 and every reply token is checked (the Reply check).
